name: Gauge / Meter
when_to_pick: Show a single bounded number as a position on a colored semicircular arc — a speedometer-style gauge with low/medium/high (or sell/neutral/buy) zone bands, a needle pointing at the current value, and a large value readout with its zone label. Pick it whenever an article reduces a state to one score on a scale: market-sentiment / fear-and-greed indices (0–100), RSI or other bounded oscillators, a volatility or risk level, account-health or margin-usage percentage, prop-firm drawdown headroom, or a backtest confidence/quality score. Use it when the *one number and which band it falls in* is the takeaway; use a chart instead when the trend over time matters.

label.description: Name of the metric shown under the value readout, e.g. 'Market sentiment' or 'RSI (14)'.

value.description: Current value the needle points to. Clamped to [min, max] for display.

min.description: Low end of the scale (left edge of the arc).

max.description: High end of the scale (right edge of the arc).

unit.description: Optional short unit appended to the value readout, e.g. '%' or 'pts'. Omit for an index/score.

zones.description: Ordered colored bands along the arc, low-to-high. Each band runs from the previous band's upTo (or min) up to its own upTo. The last band's upTo should equal max. If omitted, the whole arc uses a single neutral accent band.

upTo.description: Upper bound of this band on the scale (inclusive). Must be within [min, max] and greater than the previous band's upTo.

tone.description: Semantic color of the band. Use sell/danger for low/bearish, buy/success for high/bullish, neutral/accent/warning for the middle. sell=red, buy=green, danger=red, success=green, warning=amber, accent=blue, neutral=grey.

label.description: Optional short name for this band shown as the zone label when the needle lands in it, e.g. 'Extreme Greed'.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the gauge (plain text).
